categories.background: Surface colors for page, containers, layers, and interactive states. Use for fills behind content, not for text or borders.
categories.content: Text and icon foreground colors. 'default' for body text, 'strong' for headings and emphasis, 'subtle' for secondary text, 'disabled' for inactive content, and 'on-dark' or 'on-light' when text sits on a contrasting background.
categories.brand: Core accent palette: primary blue family, navy secondary, and yellow tertiary. Brand values are the same in both variants.
categories.status: Status colors. 'critical' is error (red), 'alert' is notification (yellow). Each status has a solid background, a subtle background, a border, and a content accent. Dark variant uses deeper fills and lighter accents.
categories.border: Outline and divider colors for inputs, cards, dividers, and focus states.
categories.link: Hyperlink colors for default, hover, destructive, and inverse contexts.

background.surface.desc: Cards and raised containers on the base background.

background.layer.desc: Secondary layered area within a surface.

background.accent.desc: Subtle translucent tint overlay (black at ~5% in light, white at ~5% in dark).

background.primary.desc: Solid primary-blue background for emphasis areas.

background.secondary.desc: Navy background for secondary emphasis areas.

background.promotional.desc: Deep navy background for banners and promotional areas.

background.hover.desc: Background shown when a surface or item is hovered.

background.active.desc: Background shown when a surface or item is pressed or selected.

background.disabled.desc: Background for disabled controls and areas.

content.disabled.desc: Text and icons on disabled controls (translucent).

content.onDark.desc: Text on dark or saturated backgrounds.

content.onLight.desc: Text on light backgrounds that need navy emphasis.

brand.primary.desc: Primary blue. Used for links, active borders, and emphasis.

brand.tertiaryTint.desc: Very light yellow tint for highlight backgrounds.

brand.tertiaryShade.desc: Orange-brown shade of the tertiary yellow.

brand.gradient.desc: Brand gradient from blue d-1 to blue d-3.

status.positive.backgroundSubtle.desc: Light success tint for banners and containers.

status.critical.backgroundSubtle.desc: Light error tint for banners and containers.

status.warning.backgroundSubtle.desc: Light warning tint for banners and containers.

status.alert.backgroundSubtle.desc: Light notification tint for banners and containers.

status.info.backgroundSubtle.desc: Light info tint for banners and containers.

border.default.desc: Standard border for inputs and cards.

border.active.desc: Border for focused or selected items.

border.inverse.desc: Border used on dark or saturated surfaces.

link.inverseDefault.desc: Link text on dark or saturated backgrounds.
